title: Snake vs Chess
summary: Tony (White) has only a king plus an uncapturable Snake against Martin's full army. The snake moves one square at a time like the arcade game, its body occupying squares, and grows one segment per capture. White wins by trapping and capturing Black's king with the snake; Black wins by checkmating White's exposed king. He beats Martin quickly (snake to d8), struggles against Smartin, then restarts with a length-4 snake and finally captures Smartin's king (~8:20).
rules: White: king + Snake. Black: normal full army.

The Snake occupies a chain of squares (head + body). Each White turn the head moves one square orthogonally (inferred: Snake-game style; transcript describes the tail square following the head, e.g. 'f5 becomes the tail... becomes g5').
Snake cannot be captured; its body squares block movement and lines for both sides.
When the head moves onto an enemy piece it captures it and the snake grows by one segment (length 2/3 at start game 1, 'now at a length of three' after a capture).
Black king may be captured by the snake head: trapping then capturing the king wins for White.
White's own king can be checkmated normally; White may move king or snake each turn.
Own snake can box in own king ('possibility of getting my king trapped by my own snake').
win_condition: Capture Black's king with the snake (it does not need to be 'checkmate'); lose if your king is checkmated.
